name: Disable firmware OTA and app background updates
description: Masks the firmware OTA stack (swu-auto-upgrade plus its timer and path, swu-core-tv, swu-service, swu-verifier-tv plus timer), the fw-update download step, the lightweight-web-engine update mount and app-store background updates, on top of the vendor /mnt/backup/OS_UPGRADE_FLAG opt-out. Leaves the manual USB reflash path intact; an OTA would wipe the root.
author: levkropp
